title: fix(pm): a contract-review record reviews only the head on its Head-sha line, never a head its prose names
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLorFBirhmeihTcEMoLFfP5)_

Fixes #27979

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:契约复核记录「审的是哪个 head」只从它自己的 `Head-sha:` 行读(首个行首 `Head-sha:` 行、值是独占码段、按前缀比对),不再扫全文里任意十六进制码段;题头里、正文首行、采纳句里写 head 的三种旧写法退役。
- 为什么改:旧读器把「老 head 的 delta 记录、正文里提到新 head 已推上来」读成新 head 的复核。实测 #27964 记录 6516042954(审 `8216bec4`,正文三次提到 `b3d92fee`):欠审清单读成已审,受管队列守卫在 `b3d92fee` 上对一个 Tier S 改动直接放行(exit 0 cleared)。一周 700 条记录里 488 条正文另带其它 sha,随时可能再发生。
- 风险与回滚:只收紧不放宽。一周 702 条记录 700 条已是 `Head-sha:` 行写法,2 条旧写法都在已合并 PR 上;没写该行的记录读为「无记录」(fail-closed),补发一条带该行的记录即可。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个 commit。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`(`CONTRACT_REVIEW_40b5a25e2613a303370e9af09a030b2f982a8961_LINE`、`contractReviewHeadSha`、`contractReviewHeadMatch` 与改正后的 docblock)→ `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`(夹具、模板说明)→ 守卫与 owed-reviews 自检里的新钉子。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test`,预期全绿,其中含「#27979」的钉子是 delta 记录对新 head 读 absent / stale。
- 需要你做的:无。本 PR 欠契约复核(席位以 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 出记录),落地档以 `GOVERNED_SURFACES` 登记为准,席位落地。

## What changes

**The defect, measured (p1, the security reason).** `contractReviewHeadMatch` (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`) scanned the WHOLE record body for any hex code span of 7 to 40 characters that prefixed the PR head, and returned the first hit. Its docblock argued this was safe because "a span that is a prefix of THIS head can only have been written once this head existed". That argument is false: a record is written after the commits it discusses, and a delta record on head A routinely discusses head B ("the PR has since moved to `B`", "cancelled by the push of `B`"). Driven with the real PR #27964 comment thread as it stood before 06:15Z (records 6515936468 and 6516042954 only) at head `b3d92fee1573d4f20f93de76b5344320e75bac4d`, on `origin/main` `8f41b2d1`:

- `latestContractReviewOnHead` → record 6516042954, sha `b3d92fee`, verdict PASS (that record's `Head-sha:` line names `8216bec475d46fe55888dd1bd07bf1b00bf6459f`);
- `locateReviewOfRecord` (`record-recognisers.mjs`) → `found` 6516042954;
- `check-owed-reviews.mjs` `recordReading` → `current`, PASS — the owed-review list read the unreviewed head as reviewed;
- `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` `runGuard` (merge_group, a Tier S `.claude/**` path, no approvals, the real thread on the PR, nothing on the card) → **exitCode 0, conclusion `cleared`, record `stands` on 6516042954**. The governed queue guard admitted a head no record reviews. CONFIRMED by a run, not a reading (the card's "likely also the merge gate" is now a fact).

After this change the same inputs read: `null` / `absent` / `stale` / **exitCode 3, `refused`, record `absent`** at `b3d92fee`, and `found` / `current` / `cleared` at `8216bec4`, the head the record's line names.

**The fix.** One shared reader, three functions in `check-half-states.mjs`:

- `CONTRACT_REVIEW_40b5a25e2613a303370e9af09a030b2f982a8961_LINE` — the `Head-sha:` key line, with the key decoration `keyLineRegex` tolerates for `Served-tier:` and `Reviewed-by:` (blockquote, bullet, bold, backticks around the key), and a VALUE that must be a hex code span of its own, the first thing after the colon (spaces or bold may precede it). The key folded into the span with its value stays refused (the #18141 control), as do a bare hex value, a lowercase key and a span below the seven-hex floor.
- `contractReviewHeadSha(body)` — the span on the FIRST such line, first line wins (as `readServedTier` reads its key), `null` when no line reads.
- `contractReviewHeadMatch(body, headSha)` — that sha prefix-matched against the head, else `null`. ⛔ No body scan: a sha anywhere else in the record decides nothing. The docblock now carries the measured instance and the counts below instead of the false argument.

`latestContractReviewOnHead`, `locateReviewOfRecord`, `recordReading` and the queue guard's `locate` are unchanged and agree through that one reader. `contractReviewHandoff`, `contractReviewClaims` and `contractReviewHold` were read: each reads the head off its own key line with its own reader (`shaMeets`) and never through `contractReviewHeadMatch`; untouched.

**The legacy dialects — decided by count, all three retired.** REST `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/comments?since=2026-10-23T00:00:00Z` (112 pages objectstack, 6 objectui, 5 hotcrm; every comment with a line-initial `## Contract review`):

| repo | records | `Head-sha:` line | head in heading | head on first body line | head in adoption sentence | head in prose only |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| objectstack | 702 | 700 | 0 | 1 (6360650327, PR #25399, merged 2026-10-23; names `448de8ca`, the PR landed at `e5f87a19`) | 0 | 1 (6397040906, PR #25774, merged 2026-10-25) |
| objectui | 22 | 22 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| hotcrm | 0 | — | — | — | — | — |

488 of the 700 line-form objectstack records also carry some other hex span in their prose. No open PR relies on a legacy dialect; the two legacy records of the week sit on merged PRs and were written by hand. Triage 6516930114 already rules that only the `Head-sha:` line counts. So the heading dialect (both spellings), the first-body-line `Head:` dialect and the adoption-sentence dialect are retired rather than bounded: a record written in one of them now names no head, fail-closed, and the repair is on the write side. The seat's own records (e.g. 6516625273) put `Head-sha:` on its own line as a code span and read unchanged.

**Record writers and templates audited** (the seat's ask), each emits or names the line in the accepted form:

- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` `contractReviewRecordLines` (`--template`, every face): prints `Head-sha: \`SHA\`` as a line of its own; the self-test drives the printed text through the locator (found on the placeholder head, absent on a real one). `--brief-template` prints no record and points the reviewer at `--template`.
- `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`: writes a record as given; its own self-test fixture spells the line this way. Its pre-write refusal `recordKeyedLineRefusals` judges only `Local-runs:` today (see Acceptance notes).
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` and `references/triage-duties.md` name `Head-sha` as the record's head; `references/contract-review.md` names `--template` as the shape (its 「head sha 独占码段」 wording predates the line, see Acceptance notes). Not edited: governed, outside this card's surface.
- The `Contract-review-claim:` / `-hold:` / `-handoff:` lines carry the head on their own line with their own readers; unaffected.
- objectui and hotcrm have no record writer of their own; their seats paste objectstack's template (22 of 22 objectui records are line-form).
- A director adoption record that quotes a verdict must carry the adopted record's `Head-sha:` line below its heading; pinned in the locator battery.

**Consumer self-tests.** `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: the `recordComment` fixture wrote `Head: \`sha\`` on the first body line — the retired dialect — and now writes `Head-sha:`; two pins added (the delta record on the older head whose prose names the current head is REFUSED; the retired `Head:` spelling is REFUSED). `check-owed-reviews.mjs`: two pins added (the delta record reads `stale` for the head its prose names, `current` for the head its line names); battery floor 6 → 8. No production code changed in either consumer; both read the shared reader.

## Tests

Self-tests on the committed tree (exit codes captured before any pipe):

- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 5089 cases (was 5084): the reader on the `Head-sha:` line, first line wins, decoration and a trailing span tolerated; the key-in-span, bare-hex, lowercase-key and sub-floor controls; the four retired dialect shapes name no head; the delta record is no review of B and is the review of A.
- `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 333 cases (was 329): the `RECORD` fixture carries the line; the adoption record reads FOUND with the line and the four legacy shapes read ABSENT; the #18141 battery now also pins that a span in the prose rescues nothing, the measured 6516042954 shape on both threads, and that the first line decides; floors raised 18 → 19 and 7 → 10.
- `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 65 cases (was 63).
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, 403 cases (was 401).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the four files → exit 0.

**Ablation (once, after the fix was committed at HEAD).** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the whole-body scan back into `contractReviewHeadMatch` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob `2904747a` → `89864c32`), ran the four self-tests, and restored (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- check-half-states: 2 of 5089 red (the delta record read as a review of B; the retired dialects named a head);
- record-recognisers: 4 of 333 red (legacy shapes FOUND; the prose span rescued the refused line; the delta record FOUND for B; the second `Head-sha:` line decided);
- check-owed-reviews: 1 of 65 red (the delta record read `current` for B);
- check-governed-queue-guard: 2 of 403 red (the delta record and the `Head:` spelling both CLEARED).

**Reproduction script** (scratch, not committed): the real PR #27964 thread at `b3d92fee` through the four readers, before and after — the readings are quoted above.

## Acceptance notes

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` line 33 says 「同形 = `## Contract review` 题头、head sha 独占码段、…」 without naming the `Head-sha:` line; the template it points at prints the line, so the shape is unambiguous, but the sentence should say 「`Head-sha:` 行上的独占码段」. Governed path, outside this card's file surface — carrier: the skills seat (a one-line docs card, or folded into the next `contract-review.md` edit).
- `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` `recordKeyedLineRefusals` refuses a record before the write only for a present-and-unreadable `Local-runs:` line. A record posted with no readable `Head-sha:` line is written and then reads as no record at all — correct and fail-closed, but silent at the write. The same present-and-unreadable discipline for `Head-sha:` (`contractReviewHeadSha` is now exported for it) would make the write side loud. Not a new gate (a write tool's refusal), outside this card's surface — carrier: the skills seat; noted, not filed.
- The two legacy records of the week (6360650327 on PR #25399, 6397040906 on PR #25774) were both hand-written by a maintainer on PRs since merged; nothing to do.
- The project-context step "assign and request a review from the requester at PR creation" was not performed: SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉 says 「`pr_create` 不请不派」 and the hand-off is the seat's after ACCEPT and a same-head PASS.

## Verification

- Gate families derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (49 commands, see the report's `gates` field and the `--ran` reconciliation): all 49 run serially on committed head 40b5a25e in a fresh worktree after pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts, each exit code captured before any pipe; all 49 exit 0; dispatch-gates --ran reconciliation: 49 derived, 49 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0); the derivation recomputed after the last commit is the same 49.
- Head verified: 40b5a25e2613a303370e9af09a030b2f982a8961.
